title: Rotgut's WMDs
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect evidence of Rotgut's WMDs from Rotgut in the Room of Creation off of Mutanous Malaise, Level 7, then return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Zone: The Mutanous Malaise

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect evidence of Rotgut's WMDs from Rotgut in the Room of Creation off of Mutanous Malaise, Level 7, then return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Offer:

I've looked over the evidence and I've come to a decision: Rotgut is a killer...of overpriced music equipment! This guy really knows how to sell his wares. But, contrary to what Dubya has to say, he isn't harboring WMDs as far as I can tell. I don't know where he got his intel but none of this evidence has anything to do with weapons, much less Weapons of Mass Destruction.

However, that doesn't mean that Rotgut is not in trouble. When we brought him in to be the Boss of Mutanous Malaise, he signed a contract that prohibited him from using Mutanous Malaise to sell his brand of top-of-the-line music equipment and accessories. Of course, this is punishable by one death, and that is where you come in.

Also, after reviewing all of the evidence and intel, there is some credence to Dubya's paranoia as the term WMD is found multiple times. We need to know what exactly this WMD is and the only way we can see to find out is to go to the source: Rotgut.

Head into the Room of Creation, where Rotgut is known to hang. Kill him and bring me any evidence of this mysterious WMD reference. When you have finished this task, you can find me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston. As always.

Turn-in:

You have something, then? Let me see. It appears to be a list of some sort.... Oh no, it is a list of names! This is very, very bad! ROTGUT IS GETTING THE BAND BACK TOGETHER!

Objectives:

  • Rotgut's WMD ×1

Level range: 30–50
